title: NOMAD: 8-Part Returning Series
description:
NOMAD is a high-octane crime drama that follows a group of young digital nomads

merging with the old guard from the criminal world. It's a fun, sex-filled, hedonistic take on

global citizens revolutionising an old economy. The dark-web, crypto, the gig economy

and good old-fashioned drug-running. It's fast, bold and unrelenting. The lovechild of

EUPHORIA and BABY DRIVER, NOMAD follows ‘Sammy’, a failed start-up fundraiser

who becomes a driver for a mysterious crypto millionaire, as he rises through the ranks of

a criminal organisation before realising, he’s in too deep. Full of high-speed chases through

the streets of Lisbon and high-stakes emotional drama, NOMAD is a tale of greed and

excess for our modern times.


Available materials: Pitch Deck / Treatment.
